Battery voltage ~12 V-க்கு மேல் உள்ளதா ப: Check that battery voltage is above about 12 V (low voltage sets many ABS codes).
Scan tool (Techstream / ABS-capable) மூல: Read DTC + freeze frame with a scan tool (Techstream / ABS-capable); on older non-CAN models jumper Tc–E1 (DLC1/DLC2) or DLC3 pin 13 (Tc) – pin 4 (CG) and count the ABS light flashes.
குறிப்பிட்ட circuit (sensor / solenoid /: Check the connector, wiring and resistance of the circuit named by the code (sensor / solenoid / relay).
சரி செய்த பின் DTC clear செய்து 20 km/h-: After the repair, clear the DTC and drive above 20 km/h for more than 30 seconds, then check again (codes such as 31–34, 13, 51 do not clear just because a part was replaced).
⚠ வேலை தொடங்கும் முன்: ignition OFF → ba: ⚠ Before starting work: ignition OFF → remove the battery negative (–) cable and wait at least 90 seconds (SRS back-up power).
Battery கழற்றும் முன்பே DTC படிக்கவும் (: Read the DTCs BEFORE disconnecting the battery (SRS-capable scan tool / Techstream; on older models jumper Tc–E1 or DLC3 pin 13–4 → SRS light flash).
Yellow SRS connector-கள் முழுமையாக lock: Check that the yellow SRS connectors are fully locked and check spiral cable continuity; never measure a squib directly with an ohm-meter.
சரி செய்த பின் DTC clear செய்து SRS warn: After the repair, clear the DTC and do the SRS warning light check (lights for about 6 seconds, then goes out).
முதலில் ATF / CVT fluid அளவு, நிறம், வாச: First check the ATF / CVT fluid level, colour and smell (hot, by the specified method).

Solenoid electrical code: connector, har: Solenoid electrical code: check connector, harness, solenoid resistance; performance code: check fluid, valve body, clutch.
Battery கழற்றிய பின் / TCM மாற்றிய பின்: After disconnecting the battery / replacing the TCM / changing the fluid, do the learning / reset with the brand tool.
EPS warning light எரிந்தால் steering கனம: When the EPS warning light is on, the steering becomes heavy (manual steering) — check battery voltage and charging first.
Scan tool-ல் EPS / P/S ECU code படிக்கவு: Read the EPS / P/S ECU codes with a scan tool; for torque sensor codes check the connector, then do zero-point / steering-angle calibration.
ECU / motor code திரும்ப வந்தால் பெரும்ப: If an ECU / motor code returns, it usually means replacing the column assembly or EPS ECU (follow the manual).
Battery கழற்றிய பின், alignment / column: Zero-point calibration is required after disconnecting the battery and after alignment / column work.
Engine DTC படிக்கவும்; scan tool இல்லையெ: Read the engine DTCs; without a scan tool jumper DLC3 pin 13 (TC) – pin 4 (CG) → check-engine light flashes (2-digit; the flash number is shown beside the code).

SCV / supply pump / EDU / injector மாற்ற: If the SCV / supply pump / EDU / injector was replaced: supply pump initialization + injector code registration (Techstream).
Security light: it must go out with the key ON.
Transponder key ECU code-களை முதலில் (B2: Transponder key ECU codes first (B2795–B2798), then ECM B2799.
வேறு key → start ஆனால் key பிரச்சனை (re-: Another key → if it starts, the key is the problem (re-register / replace); if not, check amplifier → key ECU.
Battery voltage சோதிக்கவும் (பலவீனமான ba: Check the battery voltage (a weak battery can set B2799).

Traction control (VSC) lamp-உம் ON ஆகலாம: The traction control (VSC) lamp may also come on

Sensor clean பண்ணி/swap test பண்ணுங்க (C: Clean the sensor / do a swap test (with C0200)
Sensor clean/replace பண்ணுங்க. Wiring da: Clean / replace the sensor. Repair any wiring damage.
Wiring harness fault (rear sensor wire l: Wiring harness fault (the rear sensor wire runs a longer route — higher risk of damage)
RR sensor/wiring visual inspect பண்ணுங்க: Visually inspect the RR sensor / wiring — the wire may be chafed by rear suspension movement
Sensor clean பண்ணி/swap test பண்ணுங்க: Clean the sensor / do a swap test
LR sensor/wiring visual inspect பண்ணுங்க: Visually inspect the LR sensor / wiring
CKP/CMP சென்சார் இரண்டையும் check பண்ணுங: Check both the CKP and CMP sensors
Timing correct பண்ணுங்க அல்லது faulty se: Correct the timing or replace the faulty sensor.
Boost control solenoid circuit check பண்: Check the boost control solenoid circuit
Solenoid/wiring fault confirm ஆனா repair: If a solenoid / wiring fault is confirmed, repair / replace it.
Exhaust valve control solenoid circuit c: Check the exhaust valve control solenoid circuit.
No-start சாத்தியம் (low side circuit gro: No-start is possible (if the low-side circuit is shorted to ground, a stall / no-start can occur without a DTC)

Rail pressure target-ஐ எட்ட முடியாம போகு: Rail pressure cannot reach its target
High pressure fuel lines-ஐ visual-ஆ leak: Visually inspect the high-pressure fuel lines for leaks
Return line flow rate check பண்ணுங்க: Check the return line flow rate
Rail/SCV seal condition பாருங்க: Check the condition of the rail / SCV seals
Leak source confirm ஆனதும் — line/seal/i: Once the leak source is confirmed — repair or replace the line / seal / injector. A fuel leak is dangerous — attend to it immediately.
MAF wiring repair அல்லது sensor replace: Repair the MAF wiring or replace the sensor.
Live Data-ல் MAP reading பாருங்க — Engin: Look at the MAP reading in live data — with the engine off it should be about 100 kPa
Boost/vacuum lines-ல் leak/crack check ப: Check the boost / vacuum lines for leaks / cracks
Sensor அல்லது wiring/line issue confirm: Once a sensor or wiring / line fault is confirmed, replace / repair it.
Check the BARO / MAP sensor circuit.
Intake throttle position sensor circuit: Check the intake throttle position sensor circuit.
Check the fuel temperature (FT) sensor / wiring.
Injector 1 wiring/injector replace பண்ணு: Repair the injector 1 wiring / replace the injector.
Injector 2 wiring/injector replace பண்ணு: Repair the injector 2 wiring / replace the injector.
Injector 3 wiring/injector replace பண்ணு: Repair the injector 3 wiring / replace the injector.
Injector 4 wiring/injector replace பண்ணு: Repair the injector 4 wiring / replace the injector.
Coolant level, radiator, thermostat, wat: Check the coolant level, radiator, thermostat and water pump
Fix the root cause in the cooling system.
Overspeed event driving pattern-ஐ review: Review the driving pattern that caused the overspeed event.
Turbo actuator/boost sensor fault fix பண: Fix the turbo actuator / boost sensor fault.
Live Data-ல் actual boost vs target boos: Compare actual boost with target boost in live data
VNT actuator movement free-ஆ இருக்கானு c: Check that the VNT actuator moves freely (stuck / carbon build-up)
Vacuum lines-ல் leak check பண்ணுங்க: Check the vacuum lines for leaks
Boost sensor reading calibration verify: Verify the boost sensor reading / calibration
VNT mechanism clean/free பண்ணுங்க அல்லது: Clean / free the VNT mechanism or replace it. If there is a vacuum leak, replace the line.
Intake/intercooler leak check பண்ணுங்க: Check the intake / intercooler for leaks
Boost leak fix பண்ணுங்க அல்லது turbo act: Fix the boost leak or repair the turbo actuator.
MIL flashing (severe misfire, catalyst d: MIL flashing (severe misfire, risk of catalyst damage) or steady ON
Fuel delivery பிரச்சனை (low fuel pressur: Fuel delivery problem (low fuel pressure, clogged injectors — affects several cylinders)
Freeze frame data பாத்து எந்த conditions: Look at the freeze frame data to see under which conditions the misfire happens
Spark plugs remove பண்ணி inspect பண்ணுங்: Remove and inspect the spark plugs (fouling, wear, gap)
Ignition coils swap test பண்ணுங்க (misfi: Do an ignition coil swap test (if the misfire moves to another cylinder, the coil is faulty)
Fuel trims (Short/Long term) live data-ல: Look at the fuel trims (short / long term) in live data — do they indicate lean / rich?
Root cause confirm ஆனதுக்கு ஏத்தாற்போல்: Depending on the confirmed root cause — replace spark plugs / coils, check the fuel system, repair vacuum leaks. With multiple misfires and catalyst risk, diagnose before driving (MIL flashing = risk of catalyst damage).
Cylinder 1 spark plug/coil inspect பண்ணு: Inspect the cylinder 1 spark plug / coil
Coil swap test (cylinder 1↔another cylin: Do a coil swap test (cylinder 1 ↔ another cylinder) — if the misfire follows the coil, the coil is faulty
Confirm ஆன cylinder 1 component (plug/co: Replace the confirmed cylinder 1 component (plug / coil / injector).
Cylinder 2 spark plug/coil inspect பண்ணு: Inspect the cylinder 2 spark plug / coil
Cylinder 3 spark plug/coil inspect பண்ணு: Inspect the cylinder 3 spark plug / coil
Cylinder 4 spark plug/coil inspect பண்ணு: Inspect the cylinder 4 spark plug / coil
Fix the CKP sensor / rotor fault.
Timing chain, CMP sensor check பண்ணுங்க: Check the timing chain and CMP sensor
Timing chain/CMP sensor fault fix பண்ணுங: Fix the timing chain / CMP sensor fault.
Glow relay control circuit check பண்ணுங்: Check the glow relay control circuit
Fix the glow plug / relay fault.
Glow plug lamp control circuit check பண்: Check the glow plug lamp control circuit
NOx அதிகமா வரலாம் (emission test fail ஆக: NOx may rise (the emission test may fail)
EGR valve carbon build-up-ஆல் stuck/part: EGR valve stuck / partly closed by carbon build-up
EGR position sensor skewed — actual posi: EGR position sensor skewed — the actual position does not match the command
Scan tool-ல் EGR commanded position vs a: Compare EGR commanded position with actual position on the scan tool
EGR valve/passage physically remove பண்ண: Remove the EGR valve / passage and check for carbon build-up
EGR position sensor voltage monitor பண்ண: Monitor the EGR position sensor voltage — it should change smoothly as the command changes

Black smoke (EGR stuck open-ஆ இருந்தா): Black smoke (if the EGR is stuck open)
EGR position sensor-க்கும் commanded pos: Performance mismatch between the EGR position sensor and the commanded position
Solenoid wiring-ல் poor connection: Poor connection in the solenoid wiring
EGR solenoid coil resistance check பண்ணு: Check the EGR solenoid coil resistance (multimeter, connector disconnected)
Scan tool-ல் EGR commanded vs actual pos: Watch the EGR commanded vs actual position graph on the scan tool — check for slow response / lag
EGR valve/position sensor check பண்ணுங்க: Check the EGR valve / position sensor
Check the EGR valve / position sensor. If a solenoid fault is confirmed, replace the EGR valve assembly.
EGR system malfunction-ஆல் NOx/smoke/idl: An EGR system malfunction can cause NOx / smoke / idle problems
EGR position sensor general circuit faul: EGR position sensor general circuit fault (sets when a specific low / high fault is not confirmed as P0405 / P0406)
P0405 அல்லது P0406-யும் set ஆகி இருக்கான: Check whether P0405 or P0406 is also set — if so, diagnose that first
EGR position sensor circuit continuity/v: Check the EGR position sensor circuit for continuity / voltage
EGR position sensor circuit check பண்ணுங: Check the EGR position sensor circuit.
Exhaust temp sensor 1 resistance chart-உ: Compare exhaust temperature sensor 1 with its resistance chart.
Exhaust temp sensor 2 resistance chart-உ: Compare exhaust temperature sensor 2 with its resistance chart.
Exhaust brake solenoid circuit check பண்: Check the exhaust brake solenoid circuit.
Fix the vehicle speed sensor (VSS) circuit fault.
ECM programming update அல்லது replace பண: Update the ECM programming or replace the ECM.
Power/performance குறையும் (fuel injecti: Power / performance drops (fuel injection quantity is limited)
Ignition 10 நொடிக்கு மேல் OFF பண்ணி key: The engine may stop if the ignition is switched OFF for more than 10 seconds and the key is cycled
Fault repeat ஆகுதான்னு scan tool-ல் conf: Confirm with the scan tool whether the fault repeats — if it does, an ECM internal fault is confirmed
Various drivability symptoms ECM process: Drivability symptoms vary with how severe the ECM processor fault is

No-start — engine crank ஆகும், ஆனா start: No-start — the engine cranks but does not start (the immobilizer blocks fuel injection)
Starter cut relay energize ஆகி, சில நேரம: The starter cut relay is energized, so sometimes it does not even crank
Scan tool-ல் 'Immobilizer Function Progr: The scan tool shows 'Immobilizer Function Programmed' = No
Puthusa போட்ட replacement ECM immobilize: A newly fitted replacement ECM has not had the immobilizer programmed (the most common cause)
Key/immobilizer security information ECM: Key / immobilizer security information is not programmed in the ECM
ECM reset ஆகி/adjustment value clear ஆகி: The ECM may have been reset / adjustment values cleared, losing the immobilizer data
Engine cranks ஆனா start ஆகாது (இந்த DTC: The engine cranks but does not start (when this DTC is set)
Bussed sensor (APP2/BARO/IAT/FRP/CMP/EGR: Fault in one of the sensors sharing this reference (APP2 / BARO / IAT / FRP / CMP / EGR)

Fix the ECM main relay / wiring.
Check the ECM main relay circuit.
Bussed sensor (exhaust diff. pressure/ex: Fault in one of the sensors sharing this reference (exhaust differential pressure / exhaust temperature / CKP / boost / throttle / VNT vacuum / ECT / FT)
Injector group 1 supply circuit check பண: Check the injector group 1 supply circuit.
Injector group 2 supply circuit check பண: Check the injector group 2 supply circuit.
Oxygen catalyst deteriorate/damage ஆகி இ: The oxidation catalyst may be deteriorated / damaged
VNT vacuum pressure sensor/wiring check: Check the VNT vacuum pressure sensor / wiring.
Poor fuel economy (fixed valve lift-ல் s: Poor fuel economy (stuck at a fixed valve lift)
Carbon/debris-ஆல் mechanism jam ஆகி இருக: The mechanism is jammed by carbon / debris
Actuator connector wiring/continuity che: Check the actuator connector wiring / continuity
Freeze frame data பாத்து fault எப்போ set: Look at the freeze frame data to see when the fault set (cold start / warm running)
P2646 உடன் சேர்ந்து வரலாம் (இரண்டும் ஒரே: May appear together with P2646 (both relate to the same actuator assembly)
Position sensor internal fault (actuator: Position sensor internal fault (it is inside the actuator assembly — it cannot be replaced separately)
Actuator mechanism physically stuck-ஆ இர: If the actuator mechanism is physically stuck, the sensor signal goes out of range
P2646-உடன் சேர்ந்து இருக்கானு confirm பண: Confirm whether P2646 is also present — if so, it may be the same root cause (actuator assembly fault)
Scan tool-ல் actuator position sensor vo: Monitor the actuator position sensor voltage live on the scan tool
ABS warning lamp-உம் ON ஆகலாம்: The ABS warning lamp may also come on
CAN bus wiring/connector inspect பண்ணுங்: Inspect the CAN bus wiring / connector

CAN wiring fault confirம் ஆனா repair பண்: If a CAN wiring fault is confirmed, repair it. If a sensor fault is confirmed, replace it (⚠ after replacement the steering angle sensor must also be zero-point calibrated).
